SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqLobbyListMapper.getTotalCount : 채팅내역 게시글 수 */ COUNT(*) FROM AYB260 WHERE 1=1 AND ( DEL_YN != 'Y' OR DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 상담원 조회 */
AND CLIENA_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 내담자 조회 */
AND CHTT_MEMO_CN LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 메모 조회 */
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqLobbyListMapper.selectInqLobbyList : 채팅내역 게시글 수 */
CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO , TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT , CLIENA_ID , CNSLTNT_ID , CNSLTNT_NCKN_NM , CASE WHEN length(CHTT_MEMO_CN) > 300 THEN substr(CHTT_MEMO_CN, 0, 300) || '...' ELSE CHTT_MEMO_CN END AS CHTT_MEMO_CN , RDCNT_NOCS FROM AYB260 WHERE 1=1 AND ( DEL_YN != 'Y' OR DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 상담원 조회 */
AND CLIENA_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 내담자 조회 */
AND CHTT_MEMO_CN LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 메모 조회 */
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT DESC, CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqLobbyListMapper.selectInqLobbyDetail : 채팅내역 게시판 상세 */ CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO /* 채팅로그고유번호 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID AS REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , CNSLTNT_NCKN_NM /* 상담원닉네임 */ , RDCNT_NOCS /* 조회수 */ , CHTT_MEMO_CN /* 채팅메모 */ FROM AYB260 WHERE CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO = #{CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO AYB260 ( CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO /* 채팅로그번호 */ , CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , CNSLTNT_NCKN_NM /* 상담원닉네임 */ , CHTT_MEMO_CN /* 채팅메모 */ , REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */
) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO)),0) +1 FROM AYB260 ) , #{CLIENA_ID} , #{CNSLTNT_ID} , #{CNSLTNT_NCKN_NM} , #{CHTT_MEMO_CN} , SYSDATE , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqLobbyListMapper.updateLobby : 채팅내역 게시글수정 */ AYB260 SET CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO = #{CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO} /* 채팅로그번호 */ , CLIENA_ID = #{CLIENA_ID} /* 내담자아이디 */ , CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담원아이디 */ , CNSLTNT_NCKN_NM = #{CNSLTNT_NCKN_NM} /* 상담원닉네임 */ , CHTT_MEMO_CN = #{CHTT_MEMO_CN} /* 채팅메모 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO = #{CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO}
UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqLobbyListMapper.inqLobbyDtlCnt : 비밀게시판 게시글조회수 */ AYB260 SET RDCNT_NOCS = NVL(RDCNT_NOCS, 0) +1 WHERE CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO = #{CHTT_LOG_ESNTAL_NO}
